description: Rules for replay certification. Defines what checks must pass for a replay to be considered valid.

rules.description: An evidence_freeze.json must exist from the original run.
Hashes in evidence_hash_manifest.json must match current filesystem hashes.
Original policy_decision.json must exist (for provenance runs).
The policy decision status must match the certification status.
trace.jsonl must be valid JSONL with at least one event.
step_logs directory must have at least one .json file.
final_status.json status must match certification.json status.

replay_verdicts.REPLAY_MATCH: All FAILED-severity checks pass. The certification decision is reproducible.
replay_verdicts.REPLAY_MISMATCH: One or more FAILED-severity checks failed. The certification decision may have been compromised.
replay_verdicts.REPLAY_PARTIAL: All FAILED checks pass, but some WARNING checks failed. The decision is reproducible but may have degraded evidence.
